mods.name: Skinmatics
mods.description: An avatar customization mod aims around the vanilla player model themselves

releases.notes:
- **This mod file is built using a multi-loader project template**
  - **Some feature might be missing**
  - **Expect pesky bugs and unexpected crashes when using Skinmatics**
- Changed project archive and group convention
- Reworked Lights feature to allow developers to make their own dynamic light behavior
  - Currently only have `skinmatics:simple`
- Avatar feature now require a data fixer function
  - The data fixer run for every loading attempt (will add option to disable it later to 'increase avatar load time')
- Changed how Skinmatics untrack avatar entities
- Properly implemented avatar events
